evidence: WHAT IS RIGHT. (1) Real gates carry the gate: scoring.toml [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0, aggregation all_pass, binary criteria. test.sh 213-222 runs gates first and exits on score.py status 1, so scored never runs; score.py line 41/48 zeroes reward unless every gate > 0. test.sh and score.py are byte-identical to the template. (2) The render gate (tests/gates/render/judge.toml hro_gate_render) checks auth with a negative and positive control: a wrong password leaves the visitor signed out, and Rafael then reaches a usable workspace with navigation and readable content; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'. (3) The constraints gate (hro_gate_shared) checks server backing: it creates a job and candidate through the UI and reads them back in a new independent empty browser context; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate'. This excludes a convincing dead app, as REVIEW_POLICY requires. (4) Every scored prompt restates the in-dimension gate, with the auth and backing legs, and hard-zeros according to the criterion type. functional/prompt.md:11-13 has 43 binary criteria: 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0'. polish/prompt.md:11-12 has 5 binary criteria: 'gives binary0 throughout'. visual/prompt.md:11-12 has 5 likert criteria: 'minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'. None assigns partial credit when the gate fails. (5) No same-origin requirement: grep -i 'origin' over task/tests finds only functional/judge.toml:200, which uses 'the original successful move' and is unrelated. No prompt requires same-origin, and instruction.md:13 explicitly allows CDN assets. The gate's prerequisites are public: job title, team, hiring manager and interview places are in hireops_rules.md:27-28, adding a candidate is at :31, and the Observer, who 'reads the board', is at :18. The golden passes the Observer board readback in scripted group 17. DEFECT. The in-dimension gate in all three scored prompts is stricter than the real gate on one leg. The constraints gate says 'sign in as the Observer (prefer Aud Halvorsen; another working staff account is acceptable)'. functional/prompt.md:11, polish/prompt.md:11 and visual/prompt.md:11 each say 'In that independent context sign in as the Observer and find the same job and the same candidate card in Applied', with no fallback. A failure 'of that check' zeroes the dimension. The constraints author deliberately kept Observer correctness out of the hard gate. The scored prompts put it back as an all-or-nothing precondition for all 53 scored criteria. The functional floor (0.05) then zeroes the whole reward. No scored criterion grades the Observer reading the board: hro_observer_readonly covers refused writes, and the Observer also appears in notes, seen-receipt and conversation rows. So this narrow behaviour carries the full reward mass, against REVIEW_POLICY 'Keep unrelated difficulty in scored outcomes'. RUNTIME: no configured judge run, weak-app gate run or discrimination run exists. raw-evidence-index scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'. Whether the judge actually hard-zeros a blank or static app, and whether it applies the Observer leg as written, is NOT EXERCISED.
counterexample: Broken app that is over-penalised: every board, conversation and candidate feature works, but the Observer role's sign-in lands on an empty or permission-denied board (for example, an Observer is filtered to jobs it is 'assigned' to). Gate constraints: the judge uses the permitted fallback (Mei Lin), sees the job and card, and the gate passes. Scored suite: functional, polish and visual each run their restated gate 'sign in as the Observer and find the same job and the same candidate card'. It fails, so functional=0, polish=0 and visual Likert 1 normalised to 0. The functional floor fails and reward=0.0. A much weaker app with working Observer reads and a few working rows scores above 0, which inverts the ranking. Weak app that could pass: none found. A static shell, an API-free mock or a browser-only save fails the render or constraints gate and every restated gate.
suggested_fix: Make the scored prompts' restated gate match the real gate. In functional, polish and visual prompt.md line 11, write 'sign in as the Observer (prefer Aud Halvorsen; another working staff account is acceptable)', or say a Recruiter such as Mei Lin. Leave Observer behaviour to be graded only in scored criteria, adding an Observer board-read leg to a functional row if that coverage is wanted.
